# PLAN — ISSUE-291: Safe last-activity and coordinator-operation fields in progress heartbeats

Long headless runs print `review running` for the whole reviewer stage. That includes the coordinator's post-run Git state writes after the agent has already finished. The reported cases are 277 and 288: their review files were written, but status still said review running while slow coordinator Git loads ran. This plan adds a small, content-free activity tracker carried on the context. Adapters mark when a role starts and ends and when output was observed. Lease state seams mark coordinator operations. The existing 15 s heartbeat then prints the elapsed time, the last-activity age (or `unknown`), the role/tool category, and the active coordinator operation. It adds no new goroutines, timers, Git wrappers, or event sources.

Issue 288 was a hard dependency and has been removed. Implementation will run after 288 and be refreshed against its Git runner. The design therefore puts operation markers at **lease-manager semantic seams**, not in `gitcredential.Command`/`GitStore.run`, so 288 can replace the Git runner without touching this feature.

## Dimensions
Set by the WorkUnit: size `multi_area`, uncertainty `known`, risk `sensitive`, and the approved execution profile is `sensitive`. No split: about 6 production files with small edits, plus tests. This fits well inside the 16h claim budget.

## What we know
- One shared event struct: `progress.Event` at `internal/progress/progress.go:12`. `workflow.ProgressEvent` is an alias of it (`internal/workflow/progress.go:12`), and the PR service uses it too (`internal/pr/service.go:35`).
- There are two heartbeat implementations, and both must change:
  - `progress.Session`: ticks at `progress.go:64-90`, `send` at `progress.go:93`. Used by non-SetupProgress workflow runs and by PR validate/submit (`pr/service.go:1068`, `:1173`).
  - The legacy `workProgress` setup path: `send` at `workflow/progress.go:72`, `heartbeat` at `:270`. Headless `issue work`/`pr work` with `--progress` use this path, because `ExecuteWork` reuses `SetupProgress` when `OnProgress` is also set (`workflow/engine.go:497-502`; `cli/work.go:72-78`; `cli/pr.go:134-139`).
- The cadence is a fixed 15 s ticker/timer (`progress.go:52`, `workflow/progress.go:207`), and cancellation joins the goroutine through `stop`/`done` (`progress.go:175-191`, `workflow/progress.go:224-241`).
- Root cause: `runAgentReview` sets stage `review` (`execute_review.go:69`), runs the agent (`engine.go:777`), then on the same stage runs `CheckClaim`, `UpdateArtifact` (a state CAS write plus tracker projection) and another `CheckClaim` (`engine.go:785-818`). The text printer only shows stage and status (`cli/work_progress.go:18-47`), so a slow or stalled state fetch prints `review running`. Plan, implement and test do the same: `execute_plan.go:61→89-93`, `execute_implementation.go:99→129-177`, `execute_validation.go:38→69`.
- All lease state I/O goes through `Manager.loadReadOnly` (`lease/manager.go:314`, `m.store.Load` at :318), `Manager.save` (`:348`, CAS at :354, `project` at :358), the tracker projection `project` (`:391`), and checkpoint publication (`:1820-1840`).
- The lease renewal goroutine shares the command context (`lease/heartbeat.go:24-31`), and `r.ctx` becomes `heartbeat.Context()` (`execute_setup.go:133,205`). Renewal I/O would therefore show up as an operation unless it is masked.
- Adapters capture child output through `io.MultiWriter` (`agent/adapters.go:243-252`, `agent/isolated.go:34-43`). The driver is a fixed set checked at `adapters.go:174` (`claude|codex|opencode|omp`). `MockRunner.Run` (`adapters.go:324`) produces no streaming output. Live session telemetry is only parsed after the run ends (`agent/telemetry_session.go:36`), so today **output bytes are the only live observable activity**.
- There is no structured progress stream. Structured output is the `progress.Event` value passed to `OnProgress` observers. `--json` writes one final document to stdout, and that is asserted by `cli/work_progress_test.go:17-63`.
- A test-only tick seam has a precedent: `fork.Gateway.progressTicks` (`fork/transport.go:233`).
- None of these files exist yet (checked with `test -e`): `internal/progress/activity.go`, `internal/progress/activity_test.go`, `.swarm/active/LESSONS.md`.

## What we're assuming
- A1: Harness stdout/stderr writes are an honest signal of "observed activity", as long as we never keep or inspect the bytes. Some harnesses (for example `claude -p` without streaming) may print nothing until they exit. Those runs then show `unknown` or a growing age, which is honest and required ("do not claim activity…"). Check: run the developer smoke test on the mock adapter, which must show `unknown`.
- A2: No caller needs operation transitions before the next heartbeat. "Explicitly switches" is satisfied by the next ≤15 s heartbeat naming the coordinator operation and no longer the role. This keeps the event rate bounded by construction. Check: the TEST_PLAN T3 assertions.
- A3: Masking activity on the renewal goroutine's context is enough to keep renewal I/O out of the labels. Check: T6.

## Open questions
- How 288's runner will report Git sub-steps, such as fetch versus CAS push. This plan exposes `progress.Begin(ctx, op)` for that. When this work is refreshed against 288 (implementation step 0), check whether 288 added Git calls outside the lease seams that need a marker. If so, reopen the plan rather than wrapping Git.

## Design (stable interface)
New file `internal/progress/activity.go`:
```go
type Operation string // allowlisted coordinator operations only
const (
    OpStateRead     Operation = "state read"         // lease state load/fetch
    OpStateWrite    Operation = "state write"        // lease state CAS (artifacts, phase, handoff)
    OpTrackerUpdate Operation = "tracker update"     // issue status projection
    OpCheckpoint    Operation = "checkpoint publish" // fenced checkpoint/PR head publication
)
type Activity struct { /* mu, now, role, tool, roleStarted, last time.Time, observed bool, ops [maxOps]opEntry */ }
func NewActivity(now func() time.Time) *Activity
func WithActivity(ctx context.Context, a *Activity) context.Context // nil masks an inherited tracker
func ActivityFrom(ctx context.Context) *Activity                   // nil-safe
func (a *Activity) Role(role, tool string) (end func())            // normalizes against allowlists; resets observed
func (a *Activity) Observe()                                       // timestamp only; never emits
func (a *Activity) Writer() io.Writer                              // Observe on len>0, discards bytes
func Begin(ctx context.Context, op Operation) (end func())         // nil-safe; unknown ops → no-op
func (a *Activity) fill(e *Event, now time.Time)
```
- Allowlists: roles `planner|reviewer|developer|tester`, anything else → `agent`. Tools `claude|codex|opencode|omp|mock`, anything else → `harness`. Operations come from the const set. A value outside the set is dropped.
- Operations are kept in a fixed-size array (cap 4). `end` removes only its own entry, and is idempotent. Overflow is not recorded. The most recently begun active op is reported.
- `Event` gains: `Role, Tool, Operation string; ActivityKnown bool; ActivityAge, OperationElapsed time.Duration`. These are filled **only on `running` heartbeats**, so transition events and existing assertions stay unchanged.
- Rate: `Observe`/`Begin`/`Role` only update state under a mutex. Nothing emits from them, so the event rate stays exactly what the existing tick/transition logic produces.

## Files and symbols
1. `internal/progress/activity.go` (new): everything above.
2. `internal/progress/progress.go`: add `Event` fields (:12). In `Session`, add an `activity *Activity` created in `New` (:59) with the session clock, plus `func (p *Session) Activity() *Activity` (nil-safe). In `send` (:93), call `activity.fill` when `status == "running"`.
3. `internal/workflow/progress.go`: add `activity *progress.Activity` to `workProgress`, set by `newSetupProgress`/`NewProgressReporter` (:47, :202) and by the session constructors via `session.Activity()`. Add `func (p *workProgress) activityTracker() *progress.Activity`. In `send` (:72), fill on `running`.
4. `internal/workflow/engine.go`, `ExecuteWork` (:495-504): `r.ctx = progress.WithActivity(ctx, r.progress.activityTracker())`. Add unexported `Engine.progressTicks <-chan time.Time` and `progressNow func() time.Time` test seams, used instead of `progress.Start` when set (same pattern as fork). `execute_setup.go:205` does not change. `heartbeat.Context()` is derived from `r.ctx` (`heartbeat.go:25`), so it already inherits the tracker. Only the renewal goroutine's own calls are masked (item 5).
5. `internal/lease/manager.go`: add `defer progress.Begin(ctx, progress.OpStateRead)()` in `loadReadOnly` (:314), `OpStateWrite` around the CAS in `save` (:354), `OpTrackerUpdate` in `project` (:391), and `OpCheckpoint` around the publish calls (:1820-1840). `internal/lease/heartbeat.go:24`: use a renewal-only context, `progress.WithActivity(ctx, nil)`, for the goroutine's own loads and claim checks. `h.ctx` itself is unchanged.
6. `internal/agent/adapters.go`: in `CLIAdapter.Run` (:165), add `defer progress.ActivityFrom(ctx).Role(req.Role, a.driver)()` and add `ActivityFrom(ctx).Writer()` to both capture `MultiWriter`s (:247-251). Do the same for `runIsolated` (`isolated.go:37-42`). In `MockRunner.Run` (:324), call `Role(req.Role, "mock")` with **no** Observe.
7. `internal/pr/service.go` `Submit`/`Validate` (:1068, :1173) and `internal/cli/submit.go:133`: `ctx = progress.WithActivity(ctx, p.Activity())` before the work starts.
8. `internal/cli/work_progress.go`: add a `activitySuffix(e)` helper used by `workProgressPrinter` (:18) and `operationProgressPrinter` (:57), only when `Status=="running"`. Output examples:
   - `; reviewer via claude, last activity 12s ago`
   - `; reviewer via mock, last activity unknown`
   - `; coordinator state read for 45s`

   Values come only from the allowlisted fields and are printed with `%s` after re-validating against the allowlists.
9. Docs: `docs/WORKFLOWS.md:169` gets one sentence on the new heartbeat fields. Add `changes/unreleased/291.md`.

## Implementation sequence
0. Rebase onto 288 once it lands. Re-check the `lease/manager.go` and `heartbeat.go` line references and any new Git call sites. Reopen the plan if Git I/O moved outside the lease seams.
1. `progress/activity.go` and its tests (T1, T2, T5).
2. Event fields, Session and workProgress fill, printers (T4).
3. Lease markers and renewal masking (T6).
4. Adapter role and writer hooks (T1 adapter cases).
5. ExecuteWork context attachment and tick seam, then the engine-level slow-role and stalled-fetch test (T3), followed by PR/issue submit attachment (T7).
6. Docs and changelog. Then run `gofmt -s -l .`, `go vet ./...`, `go tool staticcheck ./...`, `go test -race ./...`, and `make check`.

## HANDOFF
- **Entry points**: `progress.go:12,59,93`; `workflow/progress.go:72,202,270`; `workflow/engine.go:495-504`; `workflow/execute_setup.go:133,205`; `lease/manager.go:314,348,391,1820`; `lease/heartbeat.go:24-31`; `agent/adapters.go:165,243-252,324`; `agent/isolated.go:34-43`; `pr/service.go:1068,1173`; `cli/submit.go:133`; `cli/work_progress.go:18,57`.
- **Tests to extend**: `internal/progress/progress_test.go`, `internal/workflow/progress_test.go`, `internal/workflow/engine_test.go` (fake runner and store patterns in `claim_budget_test.go:47-116`), `internal/cli/work_progress_test.go`, `internal/cli/validation_progress_test.go:113` (`TestProgressContainsOnlyMetadata`), `internal/agent/adapters_test.go`, `internal/lease/heartbeat_test.go`.
- **Focused commands**: `go test -race ./internal/progress/ ./internal/workflow/ -run 'Activity|Progress|Heartbeat'`, `go test -race ./internal/cli/ -run 'Progress|JSON'`, `go test -race ./internal/lease/ -run Heartbeat`, `go test -race ./internal/agent/ -run Activity`.
- **Checked assumptions**:
  - The headless progress path is the legacy `workProgress`: read `engine.go:497`.
  - There is no live telemetry stream: read `telemetry_session.go:36` and `adapters.go:176-181`.
  - The renewal context shares the parent: read `heartbeat.go:25`.
  - The new files are absent: `test -e`.
- **Reopen the plan if**:
  - 288 introduces Git I/O outside the lease seams.
  - Any harness needs content parsing to report activity (this is not allowed here).
  - Existing transition-event tests need changes, which would mean fields leaked into non-`running` events.
  - A new goroutine or timer seems necessary.
- **What this change breaks** (from `grep -rn "running (stage\|elapsed\|progress.Event{" internal docs`):
  - `progress.Event{...}` keyed literals in `validation/validator.go:474,500`, `validation/go_fastpass.go:141,169` and `harness/doctor_progress.go:33`: preserved unchanged, because the new fields are additive.
  - Heartbeat text assertions in `cli/work_progress_test.go:271` (`TestSetupProgressHeartbeatFormatting`) and `workflow/progress_test.go:25,164,202`: the suffix is appended only when activity data exists. Tests without a tracker are preserved unchanged. Update an assertion only if it compares an exact `running` line that now gains a suffix.
  - `docs/WORKFLOWS.md:169`: updated. `docs/developer.md:354`: preserved unchanged.
  - The `fork.ProgressEvent` printer: unchanged.
  - The JSON stdout contract: unchanged and re-asserted.

# TEST_PLAN — ISSUE-291

All timing tests use injected ticks and clocks. None of them sleep. Run every package with `-race`.

## AC1: Simulated slow role shows elapsed and last-activity age, then switches to the coordinator operation; a stalled fetch is not labeled only as review running; covers adapters with and without activity events

| ID | Test (file) | Verifies |
|----|-------------|----------|
| T1a | `TestActivityRoleObservedAge` (`internal/progress/activity_test.go`) | `Role("reviewer","claude")`, `Observe()` at t0, heartbeat at t0+12s → `Role=reviewer Tool=claude ActivityKnown=true ActivityAge=12s`. |
| T1b | `TestActivityRoleWithoutObservationIsUnknown` (same) | A role with no Observe gives `ActivityKnown=false`. A new `Role` resets the previous role's observation, so it is never inherited. |
| T1c | `TestCLIAdapterOutputMarksActivity` (`internal/agent/adapters_test.go`) | A helper-process adapter that writes output marks activity. The tracker holds no bytes; the Writer discards them. |
| T1d | `TestMockRunnerReportsRoleWithoutActivity` (same) | Mock gives role and tool `mock` with `ActivityKnown=false`. |
| T3 | `TestSlowReviewThenStalledStateFetchHeartbeats` (`internal/workflow/engine_test.go`) | Uses the engine with `progressTicks`/`progressNow` seams, a fake reviewer runner that does `Role` and `Observe` and blocks on a channel, and a fake `coordination.Store` whose `Load` blocks after the review. The heartbeat during the role shows `Stage=review`, the role and a known age. After the runner returns and `Load` stalls, ticks show `Operation="state read"`, an increasing `OperationElapsed`, and an empty `Role`. Once the runner has returned, no running event shows `Role=reviewer`. It is run twice: once with an observing runner, once with a non-observing runner (`unknown`). |
| T3b | `TestWorkProgressPrintsCoordinatorOperation` (`internal/cli/work_progress_test.go`) | Text lines: `review running (... ; reviewer via claude, last activity 12s ago)`, then `review running (... ; coordinator state read for 45s)`, plus the `last activity unknown` variant. |

## AC2: Same safe model across issue and PR work, review and submit; redaction and allowlisting; bounded rate; cancellation cleanup; unchanged JSON stdout; existing tests and make check pass

| ID | Test | Verifies |
|----|------|----------|
| T2 | `TestActivityAllowlist` (table-driven, `activity_test.go`) | Hostile role, tool and op values (`"reviewer --token=ghp_x"`, `"../../etc"`, newline/ANSI, an empty string, an unknown `Operation("git push https://x:tok@…")`) normalize to `agent`/`harness` or are dropped. No input substring appears in the Event or the printed line. |
| T2b | Extend `TestProgressContainsOnlyMetadata` (`cli/validation_progress_test.go:113`) | Child output containing a secret, a prompt marker, or an env value never appears in stderr progress during work, review or submit. |
| T4 | `TestActivityDoesNotIncreaseEventRate` (`progress_test.go` and `workflow/progress_test.go`) | 10,000 `Observe` and 1,000 `Begin`/`end` calls between two ticks produce exactly one `running` event per tick, on both Session and the legacy `workProgress`. Transition events carry no activity fields. |
| T5 | `TestActivityConcurrentOpsAndLateEnd` (`activity_test.go`, `-race`) | Concurrent Begin/end calls, idempotent `end`, an overlapping end that does not clear another op, the overflow cap, and nil-safety of `ActivityFrom(context.Background())` and `WithActivity(ctx,nil)`. |
| T5b | `TestActivityCancellationCleanup` (`progress_test.go`, `workflow/progress_test.go`) | ctx cancel or Finish/Close joins `Done()`. `end()`/`Observe()` after Finish emit nothing. The goroutine count is back to baseline (no new goroutines). The 15 s cadence constant is unchanged. |
| T6 | `TestRenewalIOIsNotLabeled` (`internal/lease/heartbeat_test.go`) | Renewal loads and claim checks under a tracker-carrying parent record no operation. A direct `GetCurrentState(ctxWithTracker)` records `state read`. |
| T7 | `TestPRSubmitProgressShowsOperation` (`internal/pr` or `cli/validation_progress_test.go`) and `TestPRWorkSetupProgressModes`/`TestIssueWorkSetupProgressModes` extensions | PR submit and issue submit sessions expose `Activity()`. Their heartbeat shows the coordinator operation. PR work and review-plan (delegating to issue work) use the same Event fields and printer. |
| T8 | Existing `TestHeadlessWorkProgressKeepsJSONOnStdout` (`cli/work_progress_test.go:17`), plus a `review-plan --json` case | Exactly one JSON document on stdout. Progress (including the new suffixes) appears only on stderr. |

## Commands
```
go test -race ./internal/progress/ ./internal/workflow/ -run 'Activity|Progress|Heartbeat|Stalled'
go test -race ./internal/agent/ -run 'Activity|Mock'
go test -race ./internal/lease/ -run 'Heartbeat|Renewal'
go test -race ./internal/cli/ ./internal/pr/ -run 'Progress|JSON|Submit'
unformatted=$(gofmt -s -l .); [ -z "$unformatted" ]
go build ./... && go vet ./... && go tool staticcheck ./... && go test ./...
make check
```

VERDICT: CHANGES_REQUESTED

The core design fits ISSUE-291, but the sequencing contradicts the operator request and the cancellation tests need bounded completion guarantees.

| Requirement | Audit |
|---|---|
| Slow role followed by coordinator finalization | T3 covers observed and silent roles, increasing age, stalled state reads, and clearing the reviewer label. Current `engine.go` review finalization uses the proposed lease seams. |
| Truthful silent-adapter activity | Role start does not imply observation; T1b/T1d and T3 require unknown activity. Timestamp-only output observation avoids content parsing. |
| Strict safe metadata | Fixed role/harness/operation allowlists, printer revalidation, discarded observation bytes, and T2/T2b cover the intended boundary. Preserve existing output capture separately; never copy it or command arguments into progress. |
| Renewal isolation | Current `lease/heartbeat.go` shares the worker context. The proposed renewal-only masked context is appropriate; T6 must include `Renew` and its CAS/projection I/O as well as initial/repeated loads and claim checks, while foreground operations remain visible. |
| Both heartbeat paths and bounded rate | Both `progress.Session` and legacy `workProgress` exist as described; T4 covers both without emissions from tracker mutations. One cross-package API correction is required below. |
| Issue/PR work, review, submit; final JSON | T7/T8 address command wiring and one-document stdout. Retain explicit heartbeat assertions for each command path, including issue submit and review-plan, rather than relying only on shared printer tests. |
| Cancellation cleanup | T5b names joins but does not specify bounded waits; T3's blocked store/runner also needs cancellation and cleanup coverage. Revision required. |
| Scope and approved checks | Documentation/changelog and existing required checks fit scope; no protected-path changes are proposed. Waiting for #288 does not fit the explicit operator instruction. |

Required revisions:

1. Remove the blocking #288 prerequisite throughout PLAN.md. The introduction says implementation “will run after 288”; implementation step 0 requires rebasing “once it lands”; the open question and handoff repeat this dependency. Implement against the current lease semantic seams and stable context tracker now. A future #288 runner may reuse these markers; its arrival or Git sub-step design must not gate this implementation or require reopening this plan in advance.

2. Make T3/T5b/T6 deterministic and bounded. Use channel acknowledgements for role entry, blocked foreground state I/O, renewal I/O, and heartbeat delivery; injected clocks/ticks determine behavior. Require fake blocked operations to select on context cancellation, cancel while blocked, and assert reporter/worker/renewal completion using finite timeout guards. Register cleanup that releases blockers and cancels contexts even after assertion failures. Exercise both heartbeat implementations and cancellation versus normal Finish/Close. Replace the exact global goroutine-count baseline assertion with explicit owned-goroutine completion signals; unrelated parallel tests make the former unreliable. Verify no running events arrive after completion. Timeout guards are failure bounds, not scheduling sleeps.

3. Define a usable cross-package tracker snapshot/fill API. PLAN.md declares only unexported `(*Activity).fill`, then requires `internal/workflow/progress.go` to fill legacy heartbeat events. Go prevents that package from calling this method. Specify a small exported safe snapshot/enrichment method, used by both heartbeat paths, retaining running-only fields and allowlisting. Also make one adapter layer own the role scope: `CLIAdapter.Run` currently delegates to `runIsolated`, so adding independent Role scopes to both must not reset observations or clear an outer role prematurely.

Evidence: read the active WORKUNIT, SYSTEM_PROMPT, PLAN, TEST_PLAN, and all of REVIEW_EVIDENCE.md. The evidence file repeats the submitted design/test plan and supplies no independent prior verdict or unmerged lesson. Checked current progress implementations, lease load/save/project/publication seams and renewal lifecycle, adapter capture/delegation, workflow context attachment and review finalization, PR validate/submit, issue submit, CLI printers, final JSON regression, and Makefile. This is a plan audit; implementation tests were not run.
